title: Fema / RBI | SC Upholds RBI’s 5-Year Supersession Power u/s 36AAA Over Co-op Banks
description: Supreme Court holds RBI can extend supersession of a multi-State co-operative bank Board beyond six months and its original tenure.The post SC Upholds RBI’s 5-Year Supersession Power u/s 36AAA Over Co-op Banks appeared first on TaxGuru.
